mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iam_operation WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM iam_operation WHERE expires_at<clock_timestamp() ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 1000 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
DELETE FROM iam_session_grant WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM iam_session_grant WHERE expires_at<clock_timestamp() ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 1000 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
DELETE FROM iam_invitation WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM iam_invitation WHERE expires_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '24 hours' ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 1000 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
DELETE FROM iam_audit WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM iam_audit WHERE recorded_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '90 days' ORDER BY recorded_at,id LIMIT 1000 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
